summary: Supports faster permit timelines and objective standards to reduce delay-driven cost inflation; as alderman, used aldermanic prerogative to push a contested affordable-housing conversion through approval.
mechanism: faster permit timelines and objective standards

record.action: As 12th Ward alderman, urged the Plan Commission, the City Council zoning committee and the full City Council to approve the Parkview Lofts and Parkview Commerce conversion of two vacant Central Manufacturing District warehouses at 2139-2159 W. Pershing Rd. into 120 affordable and 39 market-rate apartments, over objections that the site sits about 600 feet from the MAT Asphalt plant. The City Council approved the redevelopment 36-13.
